pattern: Durable and impersonal lives in the pack. Run-specific material arrives fresh and leaves with the run. Anything identifying a person never becomes infrastructure.
postscript: If you put fresh material in the pack, you built the quiet failure: current-sounding answers from stale truth. If you packed people data, stop before building anything and read M6's opening — that one carries legal weight.
